name: back stretch
source_instructions: Stand or sit tall and clasp your hands in front of you.
Press your arms forward and round your upper back.
interpretation: Use the source-permitted standing option: clasp hands in front, reach forward while rounding the upper back, and lower the head gently. Feet remain hip-width and supported. No crossed/overhead arm requirement from1405. Retain20–30s source hold and5s2/1/2 demonstration. Exact reach, elbow poles and cadence are authored. Grip acquisition follows reachable arm placement; reverse path releases fingers before unwinding. Preserved shoulder correctives have explicit zero tracks. The separately authored WrapRightOverCuff POSITION/NORMAL component follows the3995 shoulder-protraction fraction and resets explicitly in all other actions.
